title: Step
description: One validated step of an aep.driver-steps/1 or aep.driver-steps/2 map.

map.description: The map the step belongs to.

format.description: The format version of the map the step belongs to.

kind.description: What sort of step it is.

judgement.description: What this step decides that no command could, in one line. Present on every `llm` step of a `v2` map, and on an `llm` step of a `v1` map when its author wrote one; a `command` or `operator` step has no such key (`deny_unknown_fields` refuses it).

expect.description: Which exit status is the passing verdict. A step that does not write the key holds `success`, and behaves, and digests, exactly as before the key existed. Every `llm` and `operator` step holds `success`: neither has the key (`deny_unknown_fields` refuses it, as for `judgement` on a `command` step).

output.description: A file name in the run directory the step's standard output is written to, so a later step names it as `{run_directory}/<file>`. An `llm` or `operator` step has no such key.

inputs_named.description: The run inputs the step names, each once, in the order it names them.

concurrent.description: Whether the step's state declares `concurrent: true`. In such a state each maximal run of consecutive `command` steps is one batch whose steps run at once and whose results are submitted in map order; an `llm` or `operator` step is a barrier between batches.
